quote: Moore bound was established by Edward Moore circa 1958
note: The degree-diameter problem grew out of Edward Moore's work on the Moore bound circa 1958. Moore posed the question of describing and classifying graphs that achieve equality in this bound. The problem was further developed by Hoffman & Singleton (1960) who named Moore graphs after him.
